notes: all-day à la carte plus weekday lunch 11 AM–3 PM

adjudication.rationale: Research structure, current product mappings, direct allergen authority, target repair, Ingredient Intelligence timing, focused validation, and idempotency passed the POC terminal gates.

evidence.excerpt: Current Owner-hosted ordering menu for 200 Maple Ave E lists the complete à la carte and weekday lunch catalog and provides item-level descriptions, including literal yogurt, curd, paneer cheese, semolina, butter, milky dough, and cheese references.
Current Owner-hosted catering menu for 200 Maple Ave E lists appetizers, burritos, curries, biryanis, naan, sides, desserts, and mango lassi.

Older official restaurant site matches the Vienna address and phone and supplies supporting menu descriptions, including Mango Lassi made with yogurt and milk. Its hours, prices, and several offerings are stale relative to the current Owner menu.
Current restaurant homepage identifies Chit Chaat Cafe at 200 Maple Ave E, Vienna, VA 22180, and links its menu, ordering, and catering.
Restaurant-linked DoorDash Commerce page identifies Chit Chaat Cafe at 200 Maple Ave E, Vienna, VA 22180 and exposes current ordering categories, but did not expose an allergen matrix.
